title: Person: Father Arnall
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Father Arnall

anchor.prefix:
e lit and in burning it made a light noise like a little song. Always the same: and when the fellows stopped talking in the playroom you could hear it.

 It was the hour for sums.
anchor.suffix:
wrote a hard sum on the board and then said:

 —Now then, who will win? Go ahead, York! Go ahead, Lancaster!

 Stephen tried his best but the sum was too hard and he felt confused
